title: Planner decision
description: One line in a proof run's decisions.jsonl: what the planner proposed, whether validation accepted the answer, what the call cost, and later what the gate ruled. Numbers only; no prompts, no model outputs.

step.description: 1-based planner proposal number within the run.

planner.description: Who actually picked the cap. muse-spark is Muse Spark; bisect is the deterministic rule (directly or as fallback).

allowed_caps.description: Caps the planner could pick from at this step.

proposed_cap_w.description: The cap proposed, or null for kind=stop.

reason.description: One-line reason quoting the number that drove the choice.

muse_explanation.description: Muse Spark's own plain-words explanation, when it gave one. Stored beside, never instead of, the deterministic explanation.

explanation.description: Deterministic 1-2 sentence plain-words account built from the record's real numbers. No API call needed.

proposal_accepted.description: True when validation accepted the Muse answer, false when the answer was rejected (off the allow-list or malformed), null when there was no answer to check (API error) or no Muse call (direct bisect).

fallback.description: True when the bisect rule picked instead of Muse Spark.

fallback_reason.description: Why the bisect rule picked, e.g. the Muse error.

usage.description: Token usage of the Muse call, when there was one.

usd.description: USD cost of the Muse call from the published rates, when there was one.

gate.description: What the quality/p99/energy gate ruled for the proposed cap. pending before the step is measured, stop when no cap was proposed.

p99_change_pct.description: Mean p99 change versus stock in percent, when measured.

energy_change_pct.description: Mean J/request change versus stock in percent, when measured.

quality_pass_pct.description: Answer-checked pass rate at the cap in percent, when measured.

gate_why.description: Gate rejection reasons, empty when accepted.
